title: E3SM：模擬年每日、時間邊界與科學通過率
titleEn: E3SM: simulated years per day, timing boundaries and scientific qualification
subcategoryTitle: 科學工作流與資料契約
summary: 使用原創合成資料研究「E3SM：模擬年每日、時間邊界與科學通過率」，從物理或資料契約推導計算，並以反例驗證。完成：交付模擬日曆、時間邊界圖、SYPD 與每年成本，以及科學驗收表。
summaryEn: Investigate E3SM: simulated years per day, timing boundaries and scientific qualification using an original synthetic fixture. Derive the calculation from its physical or data contract, challenge it with a counterexample, and defend a bounded conclusion. Complete: Deliver the simulation calendar, timing-boundary diagram, SYPD and per-year cost calculations plus a scientific acceptance table preserving failed fast configurations as evidence.
scope: 本課採用原創合成工作負載或事件資料，在紙面、試算表與離線模型中實作。來源用於查證具名案例；數值、擾動與驗收門檻是教學假設，不是實機效能或正式環境變更規格。實驗限自己的或明確授權的隔離環境，交付可重算的證據紀錄。
scopeEn: Use original synthetic workloads or event data in paper, spreadsheet, and offline-model investigations. References establish named case context; numerical inputs, perturbations, and limits are teaching assumptions, not measured machine performance or production change specifications. Use owned or explicitly authorized isolated environments and deliver reproducible evidence records.

stages.description: 列模擬開始結束年、日曆與牆鐘起訖，標初始化、輸出及同步；不得用五年乘固定秒假設取代模式日曆。
stages.descriptionEn: Record simulated start and end years, calendar and wall-clock endpoints, marking initialization, output and synchronization. Do not replace the model calendar with an undocumented fixed-second assumption for every simulated year.
